intro.fr: Lobotomy Corporation se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Lobotomy Corporation can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Project Moon sort Lobotomy Corporation en 2018.
text.en: Project Moon releases Lobotomy Corporation in 2018.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Kli333/LobCorp-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Lobotomy Corporation.
text.en: The GitHub repository Kli333/LobCorp-AP, home of the Lobotomy Corporation APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.0.0.0.
text.en: The first version, v1.0.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version 1.3.1.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (7 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 1.3.1.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (7 versions released).

text.fr: Lobotomy Corporation figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Lobotomy Corporation is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
